Third-party notices of Munin Assistant for Google Docs

The vendored library has its own file: vendor/typograf.LICENSE (Typograf, MIT).
The word lists and abbreviation lists below were selected, shortened and rewritten as JavaScript data in
src/text-segments.js and src/prose-lists.js; no code of these projects is included. Their notices follow.
The reporting-guideline item lists of src/guidelines.js are short paraphrases (our wording) of the items of the
checklists named at the end of this file; their attributions and licences are listed there.

====================================================================================================
Reporting guidelines: the item lists of src/guidelines.js
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Each list gives the item numbers and topics and a paraphrase of at most 12 words per item, written for this
extension (adapted from the published statements); no checklist text is copied.

CONSORT 2010: Schulz KF, Altman DG, Moher D, for the CONSORT Group. CONSORT 2010 Statement: updated guidelines
for reporting parallel group randomised trials. Trials 2010;11:32. doi:10.1186/1745-6215-11-32.
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/).

PRISMA 2020: Page MJ, McKenzie JE, Bossuyt PM, et al. The PRISMA 2020 statement: an updated guideline for
reporting systematic reviews. BMJ 2021;372:n71. doi:10.1136/bmj.n71.
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

STROBE: von Elm E, Altman DG, Egger M, Pocock SJ, Gøtzsche PC, Vandenbroucke JP. The Strengthening the Reporting
of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) statement. PLoS Med 2007;4(10):e296.
doi:10.1371/journal.pmed.0040296. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/).

ARRIVE 2.0: Percie du Sert N, Hurst V, Ahluwalia A, et al. The ARRIVE guidelines 2.0: updated guidelines for
reporting animal research. PLoS Biol 2020;18(7):e3000410. doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3000410.
Licence: Creative Commons CC0 public domain dedication.

TRIPOD+AI: Collins GS, Moons KGM, Dhiman P, et al. TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical
prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods. BMJ 2024;385:e078378.
doi:10.1136/bmj-2023-078378. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

CARE: only the item numbers and topic words are used (the checklist at https://www.care-statement.org/checklist is
© IMI LLC, all rights reserved apart from non-commercial copying for information).
